Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Servicii financiare și Servicii de inginerie
About Prime Engineering: 
 Prime Engineering Romania is part of the international Prime ecosystem (Prime Group), a growing technology and engineering organization with over 19 years of experience and more than 2,430 professionals worldwide.
 With a strong international presence across Europe and beyond, Prime Engineering delivers expertise across Engineering, IT and Telecom , supporting clients through Team Extension , Managed Services , Nearshore , Team-as-a-Service and custom solutions.
 Currently, we are looking for a Senior Network Administrator for one of our clients. 
 Responsibilities: 
Manage and optimize L2/L3 datacenter network infrastructure, including Cisco switches, routers, and firewalls.
Ensure network security, availability, and performance, covering firewalls, ACLs, VPNs, and IPS.
Troubleshoot complex network issues and provide L3/on-call support in collaboration with infrastructure and operations teams.
Support infrastructure changes, upgrades, security initiatives, and PCI-DSS compliance activities.
Maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, configurations, and operational procedures.
 If you have: 
Completed Bachelor’s degree (technical is a plus)
Fluency in English and Romanian is required
5+ years of experience in Network Engineering/Administration
Experience in AWS/Azure and data center (big plus)
Strong hands-on experience with L2/L3 networking and Cisco technologies
Experience with Cisco Firepower, ASA, FMC, and preferably ISE/Catalyst Center
Good knowledge of BGP, OSPF, VLANs, TCP/IP, routing, and switching
Experience with network security, PCI-DSS, and troubleshooting complex environments
Knowledge of automation/scripting tools such as Python, Ansible, or Terraform is a plus.
Experience with Jira and Confluence is a plus
 Location: Bucharest | Hybrid model with flexibility
 Compensation: We offer a competitive salary package tailored to your experience and technical expertise. We’ll be happy to discuss the details during our initial phone conversation.
 Contract Type: Full-time, Permanent Contract
 Working hours : Monday–Friday, 8-9:30 AM–5-6:30 PM.
 If you are ready for the next step in your career, then apply!
